from typing import Any, Sequence
from .input import terminal

header(ser)
    while True:
        line = terminal(
            None,
            defaultExit="exit",
            prompt="> ",
            historyKey="uart-transmitter",
            historyFile=HISTORY_FILE if use_history else None,
            historyLength=50,
            showExit=False,
        )
        if line is None:
            break

        command = line.strip().lower()
